answer.outline: Disallowed or oversized uploads are rejected; stored names do not use raw user path components; private download routes perform an ownership check.
suggested_steps: Do not trust file extension or MIME type alone.
Use unique server-generated storage keys and keep private content outside public static folders.
Test access denial as well as successful owner access.
